imports: Place this directory on sys.path; import FrozenDistributionObjective, ParentLayout, paired_layouts, D_NAMES from distribution_gradient. original_bindings.py imports byte-bound definition-only copies and does not import train_final.py.

constructor.signature: FrozenDistributionObjective(statistics, cfg, directions, temporal_directions, source_regions, real_regions, feature_chunk=64, device='cpu', uniform_fastpath=True)

statistics_keys.source_counts: 10 original SOURCE parent counts in category order [-1,0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]; must match source_regions exactly
statistics_keys.REAL_counts: 10 independent original REAL parent counts; must match real_regions exactly
statistics_keys.V480_center_and_scale: keys V480_center and V480_scale, shape [10,480], original frozen f64 statistics
statistics_keys.U480_center_and_scale: keys U480_center and U480_scale, shape [10,480], original frozen f64 statistics
statistics_keys.DU479_center_and_scale: keys DU479_center and DU479_scale, shape [10,479], original frozen f64 statistics
statistics_keys.D2U478_center_and_scale: keys D2U478_center and D2U478_scale, shape [10,478], original frozen f64 statistics
statistics_keys.temporal_center_and_scale: keys temporal_center and temporal_scale, shape [10,31], original frozen f64 statistics
statistics_keys.noise_scale: two frozen original REAL noise scales; no refitting in this module

cfg_required.loss_weights: all five D entries exist and equal 1

constructor.source_regions_and_real_regions: independent original parent row order; integer labels [-1,0,...,8], all ten populated. These are original region labels, not the clipped 0..7 network bins.
constructor.device: explicit CPU or CUDA. CUDA without an index resolves once to current_device. Original ADC/features/standardization/f32 matrix products remain on this device. CUDA is implemented but has not been exercised by this local CPU fixture.

layout.F: ParentLayout.full_reference(source_regions, real_regions): every original parent exactly once; each regional list is ragged and stable in original parent order; global laws use original parent row order.
layout.A_and_B: paired_layouts(S_ids, R_ids, source_regions, real_regions), both IDs exactly [10,4,32]. Returns four independent region-major 32 layouts and one region-major 128 layout. B preserves region then microbatch then slot order. A = one quarter sum of four D32 values/gradients.
layout.duplicates: Slots are never deduplicated by identity or waveform value. Same parent is gathered repeatedly from one cached endpoint and keeps one fixed noise realization; gradient accumulation sums every slot into the original parent coordinate without dividing by occurrence count.
layout.global_mass: F uses 1/N_SOURCE and 1/N_REAL independently. Sampled law uses SOURCE region mass / SOURCE regional slot count and REAL region mass / REAL regional slot count independently. Conditions use separate uniform masses 1/nS_r and 1/nR_r.
layout.validation: Rejects wrong region-major reshapes, outside-parent IDs, missing regions, mismatched population count masses, full-reference row loss/reorder and a mismatch between global and conditional occurrences.

evaluation.inputs: source_endpoint [N_SOURCE,480] f64 projected after original Box but before canonical ADC, reference [N_REAL,480] f64 original stored REAL; both on configured device, reference requires_grad=False
evaluation.graph_API: objective(source_endpoint, reference, layout, terms=D_NAMES) -> DResult(pieces, total, diagnostics). terms can select one or more unique D entries.
evaluation.detached_gradient_API: objective.endpoint_gradients(source_endpoint, reference, layout, terms=D_NAMES) -> values[name] Python scalar, gradients[name] detached [N_SOURCE,480] tensor, total_value, total_gradient, gradient_coordinate, diagnostics. Each term creates its own endpoint leaf/graph and releases it before the next term. Empty, repeated, or C term selections are rejected.
evaluation.VJP_boundary: gradients[name] is dD/dY at projected pre-ADC original-parent endpoint. Replay original source_flow_core.endpoint at fixed theta/noise/mode/device/chunk schedule; compare Y bitwise, canonical codes and strict Box free mask; inject G_Y into replay out. The feature graph has included canonical STE exactly once, and this replay traverses original Box backward exactly once. Do not inject G_Y into raw or apply a second Box/STE. No clipping, optimizer, or extra population/chunk normalization.
evaluation.network_mode: For future actual R63 network, preserve training mode, zero dropout and disabled MHA fastpath in both passes to avoid eval+no_grad path changes. The local fixture uses a nonzero toy network and does not validate real attention kernels.
evaluation.all_regions_sorting: feature_chunk blocks coordinates, never parent rows. Every conditional sort covers the complete relevant regional law and every global sort its complete global law.
evaluation.uniform_fastpath: Exact integer CDF segment plan is cached only by (nSOURCE,nREAL); torch stable sort retains original row ties. The whole feature/direction numerical path and W1 float64 distance/reduction stay on device.
evaluation.general_mass_path: Detach the whole coordinate law to host float64, use the byte-bound integer-mass helper and stable original-order sort, then put W1 value and selected first-order coordinate gradient back on input device. Frozen masses never receive derivatives.
evaluation.numeric_limit: Original full-window and temporal standardized features/projections remain float32; W1 distance and reduction use float64. This is tolerance-equivalent to original equal-size R63 f32 reductions, not bitwise equality. First-order selected algorithm gradients only, no higher derivative claim.

full_window.meaning: Four families V480/U480/DU479/D2U478; each regional marginal mean coordinate W1 and 64-direction sliced mean W1 receive one half each; SOURCE regional masses then four-family mean. Original feature normalization and frozen REAL scales retained.

PSD.meaning: One half of independent-mass global PSD W1 plus equal mean of seven conditional PSD W1 values for Q1..Q7; divide by 0.01. Seven-region conditional reduction is not weighted by SOURCE masses.

noise.meaning: Original baseline RMS and lag-one ACF. Each coordinate uses independent SOURCE/REAL global masses and its original noise scale, then the two standardized W1 values are averaged.

coordinate_RMS.meaning: In each region/family first compute each coordinate's W1, then sqrt(mean(W_j squared)); weight regions by SOURCE mass and average four families. Exactly zero RMS selects zero gradient.

temporal_joint.meaning: Original 31 baseline features: RMS, ACF lags 1..20 and ten five-bin rFFT power fractions with original Nyquist multiplicity/floor. Frozen original scaling, half marginal plus half 64-direction sliced W1, SOURCE regional mass.

source_order.meaning: Original precision-resolved source pair ranking within each 320-source microbatch, preserving the original nonzero-source-PSD-pair denominator and pair weights. Never replace with 128-region merged cross-microbatch pairs.

source_valley.meaning: Original Q3/Q4 h=1 sigmoid valley occupancy with its microbatch mean, frozen h fraction, original raw occupancy and ReLU-square excess. Never merge four nonlinear microbatch reductions.

REAL_identity.meaning: Original 64-row REAL identity canonical-output/reference squared difference normalized by frozen region V480 scale; separate original per-occurrence identity noise if constructed elsewhere.

box_correction.meaning: One half of SOURCE-mass-weighted output-minus-raw mean square plus identity-row mean square, divided by 0.5 squared. Depends on both raw and projected endpoints and cannot use the D-only G_Y interface alone.

scope_and_limitations: No scientific array, checkpoint, DEV/EVAL/CAL, optimizer update, scientific forward or scientific gradient was used for this preparation.
Artificial constants are generated in artificial_fixture.py; the hash binds waveforms, noise, stats, directions, masses, slots and toy state. It is one fixture, not a sample of scientific datasets.

The full finite reference, A and B are conditional on fixed per-parent noise, fixed directions, weights, TRAIN constants, STE and stable original-row tie branch. This does not estimate the original training expectation with independent noise for each appearance or fresh directions for each update.
The five D terms and their parameter gradients do not establish total nine-term training conflict. C remains historically defined and excluded from the main comparison.

Distinct parents with equal feature values are not merged; selected stable tie gradients need not be the unique gradient at a nonsmooth point. Hard-ADC finite differences are not a valid equivalence test for STE gradients.

Local tests execute original endpoint/Box/STE/features with an artificial nonzero toy network only. Actual R63 ResponseNetwork CPU/CUDA replay requires an independent artificial smoke before any scientific input is read.
Artificial success is not scientific registration, a science-budget grant, an A-F pass, a training authorization, or a successful R63/R64 scientific outcome.
reproduction: PowerShell -NoProfile -File run_fixture.ps1. It launches the E-drive CPU venv with -B, one-core affinity, one torch/inter-op thread, E-only temp/cache/logs and a 1.2 GiB RSS kill ceiling. Native exit receipt is separate from the artificial result receipt. FROZEN_TOLERANCES.json was written and hashed before the first run and has not been relaxed.
